title: debug.codec
description: TEST FIRMWARE ONLY (v0.3.2, issue #31). Puts the ES8311 codec into the state a power-on leaves it in (its soft reset, REG00 = 0x1F, with the microphone off), so the next recording starts while the codec still holds its output muted. warm: true then runs the boot's codec warm-up as after a real power-on. Refused with E_BUSY "live" while a recording is live. Reply: ack or error.
